games.headline: LeBron James has his 1st triple-double for the 76ers in a win over the Heat
games.desc: — LeBron James had 25 points, 12 assists and 10 rebounds for his first triple-double with Philadelphia, and Tyrese Maxey scored 30 points to lead the 76ers to a 111-104 victory over the Miami Heat in an NBA Cup game Wednesday night.

games.headline: Matas Buzelis scores 24 as Bulls hold on to beat Hornets 107-105 for 2nd straight win
games.desc: — Matas Buzelis scored 24 points, Josh Giddey added 12 points, 11 rebounds and seven assists, and the Chicago Bulls handed the Charlotte Hornets their seventh straight loss 107-105 on Wednesday night.

games.headline: Knicks blow by the Cavaliers in the fourth, win 121-102 for sixth straight victory
games.desc: — Jose Alvarado scored a season-high 21 points, Mikal Bridges had a season-best 19 and the New York Knicks rode a blitz by their bench to a 121-102 victory over the Cleveland Cavaliers on Wednesday night that extended their winning streak to six.

games.headline: Timberwolves beat the Thunder 113-106 to improve to 3-0 in NBA Cup play
games.desc: — Jaden McDaniels had 32 points and 10 rebounds, LaMelo Ball added 19 points before leaving with an ankle injury and the Minnesota Timberwolves improved to 3-0 in NBA Cup play with a 113-106 win over the Oklahoma City Thunder on Wednesday night.

games.headline: Wells and Jerome lead the Grizzlies to a 115-97 win over the Clippers, who fall to 0-9 on the road
games.desc: — Jaylen Wells scored 19 points, Ty Jerome added 17 points and seven assists, and the Memphis Grizzles beat the Clippers 115-70 on Wednesday night in an NBA Cup game, dropping Los Angeles to 0-9 on the road.

games.headline: Randle scores 28 points to lead Nets past Bucks 104-97 in NBA Cup action
games.desc: — Julius Randle scored 28 points and Noah Clowney had 17 as the Brooklyn Nets beat the Milwaukee Bucks 104-97 to snap a five-game losing streak on Wednesday night in NBA Cup play.

games.headline: Kevin Durant reaches 33,000 points as Rockets beat Suns
games.desc: — Kevin Durant scored 20 points and became the fifth player in NBA history to reach 33,000 points, helping the Houston Rockets beat the Phoenix Suns 116-104 on Wednesday night.

games.headline: De'Anthony Melton scores 24 points, matches career high with eight 3s as Warriors beat Kings 129-110
games.desc: — De'Anthony Melton scored 24 points and matched his career high with eight 3-pointers and the Golden State Warriors made 20 total 3s on the way to a 129-110 win over the Sacramento Kings in an NBA Cup game on Wednesday night.

games.headline: Avdija, Lillard lead Trail Blazers to 116-111 win over Spurs in NBA Cup play
games.desc: — Deni Avdija scored 33 points to lead the Portland Trail Blazers to a 116-111 win over the San Antonio Spurs in both teams’ third NBA Cup matchup of the group stage on Wednesday.
